note: custom_field_sdc renders an entity view mode through a Single Directory Component. Its state is a THIRD-PARTY SETTING on the entity_view_display config entity: provider `custom_field_sdc`, key `settings` = {enabled: bool, component: <sdc plugin id>, variant: string, props: sequence, slots: sequence}. hook_entity_view_alter() replaces the build with a #type=>component element when enabled+valid; the Manage-display UI (hook_form_entity_view_display_edit_form_alter) unsets the setting when disabled. Config schema key core.entity_view_display.*.*.*.third_party.custom_field_sdc. All live cases use a namespaced content type cfsdc_eval with a Custom Field field_cfsdc; the component ids used (navigation:badge, navigation:message, olivero:teaser) are real SDC plugins present on this site (verified via plugin.manager.sdc). setup/reset/cleanup create/remove only cfsdc_eval + field_cfsdc and the display third-party setting; no other module is touched. NOTE: the base field FORMATTER with id custom_field_sdc belongs to the parent custom_field module, not this submodule; these cases target the view-mode third-party setting this submodule actually owns.

evals.prompt: What does the custom_field_sdc submodule do, and where does it store the choice of which Single Directory Component a view mode uses?
evals.expected_output: It renders an entity view mode through a Single Directory Component. The binding is stored as a third-party setting on the entity_view_display config entity under provider custom_field_sdc, key `settings` (enabled + component).

evals.prompt: In custom_field_sdc's third-party settings on an entity view display, which keys control whether a component renders and which component/props/slots are used?
evals.expected_output: Under third_party_settings.custom_field_sdc.settings: `enabled` (bool) turns rendering on, `component` (SDC plugin id), `variant`, `props` (column->prop mappings) and `slots` (slot->field mappings).

evals.prompt: How does custom_field_sdc actually render a view mode as a component at display time, and what happens if the sdc_display module is active?
evals.expected_output: hook_entity_view_alter() replaces the built output with a '#type' => 'component' render element (mapping Custom Field columns to props and fields to slots) when enabled with a valid component; if the sdc_display module is enabled and controlling the display, custom_field_sdc defers to it.
